name: David Oscar Markus
tagline: Top rated White Collar Crimes attorney in Miami, Florida
about: David Oscar Markus is an attorney who represents clients in the Miami, Florida area. David Markus is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

David Markus chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Harvard Law School and graduated in 1997. David Markus passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1997.
He represents clients with Criminal Defense: White Collar issues in Florida. He also represents clients with Criminal Defense and Appellate issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, David Markus has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
